name: How long does a typical assault bike training session last at Cave Training?
description: Session length varies; standalone HIIT can be 20-30 minutes, while integrated intervals in a class might be 5-15 minutes. Our coaches design efficient workouts.

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical assault bike training session last at Cave Training?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of an assault bike training session at Cave Training can vary significantly based on the workout structure and your fitness level. Standalone high-intensity interval sessions might last 20-30 minutes, including warm-up and cool-down. When integrated into a broader functional fitness class, assault bike intervals might be shorter, perhaps 5-15 minutes, as part of a circuit. Our coaches design programs that are efficient and effective, ensuring you get a quality workout tailored to the overall class structure or your personal training plan.
